picks.rationale: First federal appeals ruling rejecting fair use for training AI on publisher content (Thomson Reuters v. Ross); a new ruling that sets precedent for anyone training models on licensed text.
picks.excerpt: A U.S. federal appeals court upheld Thomson Reuters' copyright win against defunct legal AI startup Ross Intelligence - the first federal appeals ruling to reject a fair-use defense for training AI on publisher content without permission or compensation.

picks.rationale: Primary DOJ release: indictment over $300M+ of export-controlled GPU servers smuggled to China via transshipment; concrete enforcement of AI chip export controls.
picks.excerpt: DOJ indicted the owner of a San Gabriel Valley tech company on three counts for allegedly smuggling more than $300 million in export-controlled servers containing U.S. GPUs to China via false paperwork and third-country transshipment.
